product_one_liner.value: Pack is an AI-powered workforce skills and development platform for HR teams and organizations, helping map employee skills and guide people’s personalized development and change.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Pack as a people-development/skills platform for people decisions and highlights skill mapping and data-driven development paths.

pricing_page.notes: The public homepage links to the product, LinkedIn, terms, and privacy information but offers no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The company has a case-studies page, but the available page/index content did not identify customer names; therefore no names meet the requirement.

employee_band.notes: A December 2025 report put the team at 30 and described a plan to grow to around 50. That supports the 21–50 band, though it is not a live headcount.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom identifies Barcelona as Pack’s headquarters; the company’s indexed vacancy page describes Barcelona as its first HQ.

founded_year.notes: The report states Pack was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows HR, workforce, and marketing/editorial material, not at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public homepage exposes no product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link; it links to legal pages and LinkedIn.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Pack job-board page reports no relevant job openings; no open AI/ML/data-science role was found.

model_provider.notes: Checked the public product site, its available product/blog material, and the linked privacy policy; none publicly names a model or AI provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Pack’s indexed product-page copy explicitly says it complies with GDPR. No other listed certification was substantiated.

last_funding.notes: The latest reported round was a €5.8 million Series A announced in December 2025. The USD amount is an approximate conversion of €5.8 million using the contemporaneous EUR/USD exchange rate.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced in December 2025, within the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Pack job-board page reports no relevant job openings, so no current SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening was found.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog material found was dated before the six-month window and was not a launch announcement. The current homepage says the platform is launching on December 1, 2026, which is after the run date, not a launch in the preceding six months.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current accessible company page did not provide a sufficiently verifiable full team roster or dated C-level/VP join/leave information for the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The indexed company vacancy listing names HubSpot in its CRM requirement.
